name: Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026
short_description: A multi-distance road race in Kuching, Sarawak, offering full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km options on 9 August 2026.
ai_summary: The Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 takes place on 9 August 2026 at Menara Sarawak Energy in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia. Organized by Sarawak Energy Berhad, the event offers four distance options: full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open, with prices ranging from RM40 to RM140 depending on the category chosen.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit different runner levels
Affordable pricing range from RM40 to RM140
Organized by an established company, Sarawak Energy Berhad

faqs.question: When is the Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on 9 August 2026. The event will be held at Menara Sarawak Energy in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia, and is organized by Sarawak Energy Berhad, offering runners several distance categories to choose from on race day.

faqs.question: What distance options are available?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from four distance categories at this event: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range of options allows both experienced marathoners and casual runners to participate in the same event.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: Registration pricing for the Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 ranges from RM40 to RM140, depending on which distance category a participant selects. The exact fee within this range corresponds to the specific race distance chosen, from the shorter 5km up to the full 42.195km marathon.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 is currently open. Interested participants can sign up for one of the four available distances, the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, or 5km, at prices ranging between RM40 and RM140 depending on the category selected.
